treatment.logline: At a rain-soaked canal gate, Aruni recognises Nimal, finds a marked key enclosed in his fist, and receives no answer from Dinu.

arc.beat: An ordinary walk stops at recognition.
A restrained approach gives way to the key's unanswered significance.
An appeal and an unsuccessful attempt at contact leave Aruni alone with the discovery.
Black and a separate title withhold explanation.

treatment.approach: Locked-off observation and sustained faces; make the discovery through geography, recognition, then a still hand rather than spectacle. The sixty-second source bin expands the short script through indispensable approach, recognition and unanswered-contact coverage, not new events. Keep all action in real time.

treatment.geography: Paddy-field path leads from frame left toward the canal gate at frame right. Nimal lies along the gate-side bank, head toward frame right. Keep cameras on the field side of the path-gate axis. Aruni carries the small medical bag in her left hand throughout; her right hand approaches Nimal's hand and later handles the phone implied by the contact attempt. The key remains enclosed in Nimal's right fist.
treatment.key_image: A short length of marked metal visible between the curled fingers of an otherwise motionless hand.
advice: Do not remove or drop the key; its journey is not resolved here.
Avoid generated hand-to-hand contact: conceal the actual contact point behind the foreground arm while showing Aruni's controlled reach and settled posture.
The phone is the minimal practical implementation of the stated contact attempt; show no invented messages or response.
Use clean source black plates; add the exact supplied title in post, not generated typography.

sequences.purpose: Show restrained contact and the key without changing possession.

moments.what: Aruni walks along the field edge, stops at the gate-side figure, and recognises Nimal.
moments.cut_uses: A field-side wide establishes the approach; a gate-side medium shows the still figure; Aruni's eye-level single holds recognition. These are successive discovery beats, not interchangeable ornament.

moments.what: Aruni lowers herself beside Nimal, reaches toward his hand, and holds without an outcry.
moments.cut_uses: A medium profile covers the lowering and obscured contact; a closer held single receives its consequence, with the same final hand position.

moments.what: The marking on the key is visible within Nimal's fist.
moments.cut_uses: A static hand detail makes the marking readable, followed by Aruni's downward-looking reaction. Both are required to connect evidence to recognition.

moments.what: Aruni delivers L3 toward the absent Dinu.
moments.cut_uses: One eye-level close single performs L3 in full, with silence on either side.

moments.what: Still kneeling, Aruni attempts phone contact and waits without a response.
moments.cut_uses: A medium single establishes the phone at her ear; a tighter held reaction continues the unanswered wait without a new attempt.

moments.what: Aruni remains beside Nimal as a distant bus horn mingles with the rain.
moments.cut_uses: Return to the field-side wide, holding both figures and the distance while the horn stays offscreen.

moments.what: The canal image cuts cleanly to black.
moments.cut_uses: A plain black source plate provides a clean editorial stop, not a fade.

moments.what: The supplied title appears on black in post.
moments.cut_uses: A separate black source plate carries the post-built title, preserving separation from the preceding black beat.

editor_notes: The 13 must sources total 60 seconds; use their held reactions and unanswered interval to shape the intended scene, rather than treating source duration as a locked runtime.
The opening wide establishes path-to-gate geography; the still-figure medium and Aruni's close reaction deliver identification. Preserve the field-side axis and the head-right orientation.

Use the kneeling two-shot for the descent, with the contact point hidden by Aruni's sleeve. Stage the apparent hand contact with separation or a concealed composite: do not ask Veo to generate touching bodies. Nimal remains completely still throughout.

The key detail is essential evidence, not a change of possession. Keep it enclosed in Nimal's right fist; if the C-17 marking is not legible, add a tracked post marking without moving or opening the hand.

Aruni retains the bag in her left hand. The phone is implied by the contact attempt, initially held low at her lap after the previous close-up; use the close framing to bridge its acquisition without inventing a separate retrieval or rapid finger work. The appeal L3 precedes the phone attempt as scripted; no response is heard.

Keep rain continuous and place the single distant bus horn in the wide shot's sound mix; no bus is shown. For clips flagged silent, build the rain, breath and horn as separate post layers rather than relying on generated sound. No music is required.
Cut directly to the first black plate, then add EKAMA SAKSHIYA in post on the separate second black plate. Generated text is unreliable; no transition pair is needed for the hard cut.

No speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in or split screen is required; if considered later, apply only in post to clean sources. No slow motion is authorised for this scene. Avoid mirrors, fast finger work, visible body contact and invented action or dialogue.

editor_notes: The 13 must sources total 60 seconds; use their held reactions and unanswered interval to shape the intended scene, rather than treating source duration as a locked runtime.
The opening wide establishes path-to-gate geography; the still-figure medium and Aruni's close reaction deliver identification. Preserve the field-side axis and the head-right orientation.

Use the kneeling two-shot for the descent, with the contact point hidden by Aruni's sleeve. Stage the apparent hand contact with separation or a concealed composite: do not ask Veo to generate touching bodies. Nimal remains completely still throughout.

The key detail is essential evidence, not a change of possession. Keep it enclosed in Nimal's right fist; if the C-17 marking is not legible, add a tracked post marking without moving or opening the hand.

Aruni retains the bag in her left hand. The phone is implied by the contact attempt, initially held low at her lap after the previous close-up; use the close framing to bridge its acquisition without inventing a separate retrieval or rapid finger work. The appeal L3 precedes the phone attempt as scripted; no response is heard.

Keep rain continuous and place the single distant bus horn in the wide shot's sound mix; no bus is shown. For clips flagged silent, build the rain, breath and horn as separate post layers rather than relying on generated sound. No music is required.
Cut directly to the first black plate, then add EKAMA SAKSHIYA in post on the separate second black plate. Generated text is unreliable; no transition pair is needed for the hard cut.

No speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in or split screen is required; if considered later, apply only in post to clean sources. No slow motion is authorised for this scene. Avoid mirrors, fast finger work, visible body contact and invented action or dialogue.
blend_notes: c14: Cut into the established unanswered wait in c09 or c10, then return to c10; carry Aruni's c09/c10 rain and unanswered-contact audio, with no response added.
c15: Follow c11 as the final live image, carrying c11's rain and distant bus horn; cut directly to the black of c12.
c16: Optionally cut away from c08 to the bag grip during Aruni's L3, using c08 audio throughout, then return to her face.
c17: Open before c01 with rain ambience bridging into the field-side approach; no dialogue.

review.why: The low paddy foreground provides a tactile opening and a new scale before the locked geography and recognition coverage.
The concealed contact and held consequence already express restraint; a literal contact insert would weaken that choice.
The locked readable key detail and downward reaction already connect the evidence to Aruni without changing possession.
An optional bag-and-hand detail gives L3 a restrained visual counterpoint without repeating the performing close-up.
The phone-and-grip detail gives the unanswered wait a physical texture distinct from the held facial reaction.
A field-side crane retreat expands the isolation around the figures and carries the remote horn into the hard cut.
The clean black plate is the editorial stop; an added image would compromise it.
The separate black title plate preserves the intended post-built title without competing imagery.
